ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Care for PRACTICES be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
